title: First Friday Art Walk: Community Raku Firing
cost_text: $20 deposit for first piece, then $0.10 per cubic inch of work
pay_text: $20 deposit (covers first piece), balance due on arrival before loading
how_to_join: Register in advance for the firing
source_quote: First Friday Art Walk: Community Raku Firing Friday, November 6, 2026 5:00 PM 8:00 PM
summary: Public community raku firing where you bring bisqued pots to fire on November 6, 2026. Participants load fees per piece and can watch the reduction process afterward.
evidence_sentence: The shop hosts a public community raku firing on November 6, 2026 where potters can fire their own raku-body work for a deposit and per-cubic-inch fee.
evidence_quote: Everyone is welcome to join us for our community raku firing! Whether you'd like to participate with your own work or simply watch the process, it's a great opportunity to experience the excitement of raku and connect with fellow ceramic artists.
